text: Free roguelite demo where reality changes every two minutes.
The ground, the enemies, even the rules.
You pick mutations like lightning, poison and lasers, and combine them into builds.
Best part: late in a run, chain lightning and a huge purple blast fill the screen.
The catch? Some of the scenery looks like flat stickers on the ground.
The demo is about eight hundred megabytes, English only, and the full game is planned for early twenty twenty-seven.
Think Vampire Survivors, where the map won't sit still.
Worth a dip if one arena gets boring.
